messages.author: Kankana Bhattacharjee
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I performed the MM-PBSA calculation of the protein-ligand complex. I have
energetic components of each frames (energy.dat). Now how to perform
autocorrelation function of the energetic components and total free
energy change ?
Your suggestions would be appreciated.
Thanks & Regards
Kankana Bhattacharjee

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Autocorrelations can be calculated with the autocorr keyword in CPPTRAJ once you read in the data with the readdata keyword.
Hope that helps.
Best,
Matthew
